headline: Light dawn wind and some period — the pick of the region this morning.
today: Best setup around today: light WSW at dawn going cross-off, a good SE angle, and up to 8s on the sets. Fish or log the morning through toward the 9:33 high before the SSW cross comes up in the afternoon. This is the cleanest quality window of the day anywhere on the board.

daysToWatch.note: W offshore in the afternoon backing off to light NW evening, good SE angle — the drive-worthy window this week if it holds.
Light and glassy all day with a prime ESE angle, but small and short-period. Clean but tiny.
